name: chipos-verilog-lsp
description: Verilog/SystemVerilog LSP client for ChipOS IDE — spawns Verible (format / lint / outline / goto-def via lexer) and svlangserver (hover / completion / cross-file goto-def / rename). Both ship bundled, both default on, both configurable via chipos.verilog.lsp.* settings.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: LSPs run external binaries that may execute arbitrary commands (svlangserver, verible-verilog-ls); both are disabled in untrusted workspaces.

chipos.verilog.lsp.verible.enabled.description: Enable Verible LSP (verible-verilog-ls) — provides format-on-save, lint diagnostics, hover info. Requires verible-verilog-ls on PATH (install: `brew install verible` on macOS, apt on Linux). Falls back gracefully to syntax-only if binary not found.

chipos.verilog.lsp.verible.path.description: Absolute path to verible-verilog-ls binary. Empty = auto-discover on PATH. Override when you have a non-default install.

chipos.verilog.lsp.svlangserver.enabled.description: Enable @imc-trading/svlangserver for hover, completion, cross-file goto-def, and rename — primarily SystemVerilog-focused but also handles .v. Bundled into the extension; requires `node` on PATH at runtime (Electron's bundled JS runtime can't host arbitrary npm packages). Set to false to disable if you only want Verible.

systemverilog.includeIndexing.description: (svlangserver) Glob patterns of files to index for cross-file symbol resolution (hover / completion / goto-def). ChipOS default includes both .sv/.svh and .v/.vh — upstream svlangserver default is only .sv/.svh.

systemverilog.excludeIndexing.description: (svlangserver) Glob patterns of files to skip when indexing. ChipOS default excludes common simulation/build/log/debug output directories so the indexer doesn't time out on generated artefacts (typical symptom: 'Timeout trying to index document'). Upstream svlangserver default is only ['**/test/**'].

systemverilog.disableLinting.description: (svlangserver) When true, svlangserver skips invoking its external linter (verilator / iverilog). Default true because verible-verilog-ls already provides style lint via diagnosticProvider — running a second SV-semantic lint pass would surface duplicate Problems and slow saves. Set false + `systemverilog.linter='verilator'` if you want the stronger semantic lint.

systemverilog.linter.description: (svlangserver) Linter to invoke on save when `systemverilog.disableLinting` is false. Only 'verilator' and 'icarus' are supported by svlangserver. Requires the chosen binary on PATH; ChipOS auto-installs both via the oss-cad-suite pack.
